# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-11-04

- First version: Exa remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
- Endpoint taken from the vendor's repository (exa-labs/exa-mcp-server at 93c0d5e).
- The vendor's `client=agent-plugin` query and `x-exa-source` header are not copied. They label traffic as coming from the vendor's plugin.
